modules.name: Dual Universal Slope Generator (DSG)
modules.description: Two slope generators: envelope, LFO, oscillator, slew, divider, follower.

modules.name: Smooth & Stepped Generator (SSG)
modules.description: Slew limiter with hold, sample-and-hold with slew limiting, and a coupler comparator.

modules.name: New Timbral Oscillator (NTO)
modules.description: VCO with saw, triangle, sine and variable outputs, linear FM, sync and portamento.

modules.name: Wave Multipliers (VCM)
modules.description: Three waveshapers: VCA or squarer, odd-harmonic folder, even-harmonic rectifiers.

modules.name: Variable Q VCF (VCFQ)
modules.description: State-variable filter with voltage-controlled Q, AGC input and trigger ringing.

modules.name: Variable Slope VCF (VCFS)
modules.description: State-variable filter whose slope runs from 6 dB/oct to resonant.

modules.name: Resonant Equalizer (RESEQ)
modules.description: Ten fixed bands spaced at major sevenths, with two comb outputs.

modules.name: Triple Waveshaper (TWS)
modules.description: Three shapers that turn a sawtooth into a sine.

modules.name: Ring Modulator (RING)
modules.description: Ring modulator with a dry-to-AM-to-ring control and carrier shaping.

modules.name: Noise Source (NOI)
modules.description: White, pink and S/H source noise.

modules.name: Analog Shift Register (ASR)
modules.description: Three-stage analog shift register.

modules.name: Dual Comparator (COM)
modules.description: Two comparators with threshold knobs.

modules.name: Dual Schmitt Trigger (STR)
modules.description: Two Schmitt triggers and a set-reset flip-flop.

modules.name: Dual Processor (PRC)
modules.description: Two three-input attenuverting mixers with offset.

modules.name: Cross-Fader (XFAD)
modules.description: Equal-power cross-fader with output VCA.

modules.name: Dual VCA (VCA2)
modules.description: Two exponential VCAs.

modules.name: Dual Audio Mixer (MIX)
modules.description: Two four-input mixers.

modules.name: Dual Channel Stereo Mixer (DCSM)
modules.description: Two voltage-controlled stereo channels with opposite pan CV.

modules.name: Peak & Trough (PT)
modules.description: Higher and lower of two voltages.

modules.name: Wilson Analog Delay (WAD)
modules.description: Bucket-brigade delay with taps at one and two times the delay, switched feedback, voltage-controlled filters, flange and 1 V/oct outputs.

modules.name: Frequency Shifter (FRS)
modules.description: Single-sideband frequency shifter with its own quadrature oscillator, UP and DOWN outputs with VCAs, and a compressed output.

modules.name: Bi-Directional Router (BDR)
modules.description: Three voltage-controlled switches: one signal to either of two places, or either of two signals to one.

modules.name: Pulse Divider (PDIV)
modules.description: Divides a pulse train by 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7 and 8 at once.
